none: PAS LIN-B7B53E: Roman silver TOT ring bezel
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver setting from a Roman silver finger ring. The setting is oval, flat, and would have been placed into the bezel of a ring. The setting is inscribed with the letters TOT, an abbreviation of the Celtic god-name Toutatis or Totatis.
